descriptions.zh: 该接口为异步接口，实例的重启不是立即完成的，成功调用后，实例会先进入重启中（restarting）状态，当返回的状态为运行中（running）时代表重启成功。
descriptions.en: This is an asynchronous interface. Instance restarts are not immediate. After a successful call, the instance first enters the restarting state. The instance is successfully restarted when its status returns to running.
